caption: The drawing features two line diagrams of a table, both rendered in black ink on a beige background. Each diagram shows a different view of the same table object: the left diagram presents a front view, and the right diagram presents a side view. The table has four curved legs and a rectangular top, with the shape of the top and legs clearly outlined. Several horizontal and vertical dimensions are indicated with double-headed arrows and numerical measurements in inches. The front view gives the width of the table as 31 inches at its widest, 29, 28, and 25 ½ inches for intermediate widths of the tabletop, and 26 inches for the width at the legs. Height and thickness dimensions are also provided, such as a height of 3 ½ inches for a section of the top and an additional thickness of 1 ⅞ inches on the side. The side view provides tabletop widths of 19, 18 ¾, and 16 inches and a vertical measurement of 20 ¼ inches for the total height from the base to the tabletop. The drawing includes handwritten text at the bottom right, indicating "SILVER TABLE NO. 15168," and a signature, as well as additional notes and a date in blue ink at the bottom left.
title: Silver Table
